title: Bobby Hackett's band at Nick's: Billy Maxted, Phil Olivella, Andy Russo
summary: The Hackett group had pianist Billy Maxted, clarinetist Phil Olivella and trombonist Andy Russo, a new world for Leeman.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And Nick used to play the piano -- they always had the house piano player that just played solo piano, and then he'd have two pianos, you know? So Bobby Hackett asked me to go in there, when I went in with Bobby Hackett, he had a -- Billy Maxted was on piano, a very good piano player. But he had just got out -- he was, and people

don't know this, that he was a pilot, a fighter pilot during the war, and he was trying to get himself straightened out, too. He needed a job. So we all went in together. He used to write arrangements for Bob Crosby's great orchestra.
So he was the piano player. Phil Joe
Beautiful clarinet player. His claim to fame, I can't put a finger on, but everybody knew him.
His claim to fame was he was a great human being.
Oh yes, along with being a great player. We had a fine old Dixieland trombone player ...
